name: o4aa-all-agentic-flows
description: Okta for AI Agents (O4AA) — all agentic flows: chat app + agent that walks the id-JAG / access-token chain to call an inventory MCP server, visualizing every API call. Every client, including the login web apps, authenticates with public/private key (private_key_jwt) — no client secrets.

scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
